# WebScan v2.8.1 - Precision-Focused Scanning

## English

WebScan v2.8.1 focuses the default scan on actionable vulnerabilities and
substantially reduces crawl-related noise without sacrificing confirmed findings.

### Highlights

- False positives on the local benchmark reduced from 99 to 4 candidate findings.
- Recall remains 100% (22/22 planted findings detected).
- Origin-correct probing for config files and sensitive directories.
- More conservative prototype-pollution detection for framework bundles.
- Static assets no longer repeat document-level header findings.
- Site-wide deduplication across crawled URLs for DNS, security.txt,
  technology, and framing observations.
- DNS, technology fingerprinting, and robots/sitemap checks are now opt-in
  recon checks in the focused default profile.

## Русский

WebScan v2.8.1 делает default-скан более точным и сфокусированным на реальных
уязвимостях, заметно уменьшая шум при crawl без потери подтверждённых findings.

### Основные изменения

- Candidate false positives на локальном benchmark уменьшились с 99 до 4.
- Recall сохранён на уровне 100% (обнаружены 22 из 22 planted findings).
- Исправлена проверка config files и sensitive directories через origin сайта.
- Ужесточена эвристика prototype pollution для framework-бандлов.
- Статические assets больше не повторяют document-level findings по headers.
- Добавлен site-wide dedup для DNS, security.txt, technology и framing findings.
- DNS, fingerprinting технологий и robots/sitemap перенесены в opt-in recon
  проверки focused default-профиля.

### Установка / Install

```bash
pip install --upgrade webscan-security==2.8.1
```

Only scan systems you own or have explicit permission to test.
